newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Bad weather prompts Yeltsin return - Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: Bad weather prompts Yeltsin return - Kremlin.

text.p: Boris Yeltsin has decided to interrupt his holiday and return early to Moscow on Wednesday only because of bad weather, Interfax news agency quoted his spokesman as saying.

"His departure is linked to one circumstance -- bad weather," Sergei Yastrzhembsky told reporters at the Black Sea resort of Sochi, clearly referring to public concerns about the health of the Kremlin leader who had undergone heart surgery last November.
Yastrzehmbsky said Yeltsin had taken the decision to return on Monday. "The president stuck to his decision even though the weather in Sochi is improving a little," Yaztrzehmbsky said.
Television pictures from Sochi earlier on Wednesday showed Yeltsin wearing a sweater during a meeting with Interior Minister Anatoly Kulikov although the sun was shining outside.

An official from the Meteorological Centre said the temperature in Sochi was around 18 degrees Celsius (64 Fahrenheit) but there could be cloud. It had been raining there over the past few days, she added by telephone.

Yeltsin met Kulikov to discuss tensions in southern Russia after a series of violent incidents there. He also met First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov in Sochi to discuss the latest anti-corruption campaign and tighter state control on the alcohol market.
